statements.quote: Cost of revenue - AI Cloud Services for the years ended June 30, 2025 and 2024 was $1.3 million and $0.4 million, respectively.
statements.notes: Segment cost of revenue (electricity, employee benefits, other direct expenses) for AI Cloud Services, excluding depreciation and amortization; treated as AI opex. The FY2024 figure of $0.4 million in the same sentence is for a prior year and is not recorded.

statements.quote: Further in August 2025, we entered into a purchase order with respect to an additional approximately 4.2k NVIDIA B200 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $193 million and entered into a further purchase agreement for approximately 1.2k NVIDIA B300 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $71.4 million.
statements.notes: Post-fiscal-year-end purchase commitment for AI GPUs (B200), expected delivery by end of calendar 2025. The sentence states two separate amounts; each is recorded on its own and they are not summed. Classified as outlook because the spend is committed but was not yet made in the reported year. No fiscal year is named; August 2025 falls after the June 30, 2025 year end.

statements.quote: Further in August 2025, we entered into a purchase order with respect to an additional approximately 4.2k NVIDIA B200 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $193 million and entered into a further purchase agreement for approximately 1.2k NVIDIA B300 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $71.4 million.
statements.notes: Second amount in the same sentence: B300 GPU purchase agreement. It is the same kind of committed, not-yet-spent capex as the B200 purchase.

statements.quote: The increase in total commitments was primarily due to an increase in commitments related to our expansion into HPC and AI services and includes committed capital expenditure on computer hardware and infrastructure related to site development at Horizon 1 at the Childress site and the Sweetwater 1 data center site.
statements.notes: Says AI/HPC expansion is the primary driver of the increase in committed capital expenditure. The total commitments of $368.8 million appear in the previous sentence, which does not link them to AI, so no amount is recorded. Classified as outlook because the commitments are future spend.
